resources.string: Detects which app comes to the foreground so AppLocker can show its lock screen. It cannot read anything on screen.
Protection: DEGRADED — Accessibility disabled, apps are not being blocked
Turn on the AppLocker Accessibility service first (Continue setup).
Locked apps will open freely until you turn it on again. This cannot be done while a block or the bedtime lock is active.
Locked apps are open right now.
Locked apps are locked by the bedtime lock until %1$s.
Locked apps are locked by \"%1$s\" until %2$s.
Protection stays OFF until the missing permissions are granted.
Android blocks some permissions for apps installed from a file. Open app info, tap the three-dot menu, choose Restricted settings, then come back.
Needed to detect when a locked app opens and show the lock screen. AppLocker only sees which app is in front, never what is on screen.

Skipped for now. AppLocker plans to show its lock screen through the Accessibility service, which needs no extra permission. Phase 1 uses the Accessibility overlay, so nothing needs to be granted here.
Needed as a backup detector and to count time spent in locked apps.
Needed to count steps in your earn window. AppLocker only reads steps and never writes health data.
Health Connect is not available on this device.
If the prompt does not appear, open Health Connect settings and allow Steps for AppLocker there.
Needed so Android does not stop blocking and step syncing in the background.
Needed for the notification Android requires while protection is running.
How AppLocker uses your health data
AppLocker reads your step count from Health Connect to decide when locked apps may open. The data stays on this device. It is never written back, uploaded, or shared.
There is no emergency unlock. Wait for the lock to end.
Strict: this cannot be changed until %1$s.
Only the apps you switch on below are locked.
Every app is locked unless you switch it on below to allow it.
Sorted: selected apps first, then A to Z.
A block or break that is active right now cannot be edited, disabled or deleted until it ends.
The end is earlier than the start, so this runs past midnight into the next morning.
Bedtime %1$s, lock starts %2$d minutes before, ends %3$s.
Locked from %1$s to %2$s every day, overriding breaks.
Lock starts this many minutes before bedtime
The lock would start at the same minute it ends. Change the bedtime, the lead or the end time.
